blocks.text: Anasir (elements) ke periodic table ko chemistry ki alamat (symbol) kehna bilkul durust hai. Yeh kimiyai ilm ka ek aham aur mukammal zariya hai aur ek sade chart se kahin barh kar hai; anasir ki is ba-tarteeb darja-bandi (classification) aur tarteeb ke baghair chemistry ke wasee maidan ko samajhna mushkil hota. Maujooda table mein anasir atomic number, electronic configuration aur baar baar dohrai jane wali kimiyai khusoosiyat ke mutabiq rakhe gaye hain, jo 118 anasir aur un ki khusoosiyat samajhne ki bunyad deta hai.

Sirf teen sadiyan pehle ek darjan se kam anasir maloom the. 1700 tak sirf 12 pehchane gaye the: sona, chandi, tanba, loha, seesa, teen (tin), para (mercury), phosphorus, sulfur, carbon, zinc aur arsenic. Jaise mazeed daryaft hue, scientists ne unhen ba-qaida tarteeb dene ki koshish ki.

items: Antoine Lavoisier ne 18wein sadi ke aakhir tak maloom anasir ko dhaaton (metals) aur ghair-dhaaton (non-metals) mein baantne ki koshish ki.

Dobereiner ne 1829 mein anasir ko triads, milti-julti khusoosiyat wale teen teen ke girohon, mein rakha, aur dekha ke darmiyani unsur ka atomic weight baqi do ke ausat ke qareeb hota hai; lithium, sodium aur potassium ek misal hain.

John Newlands, ek English chemist, ne 1864 mein 62 maloom anasir mein pehli baar dauriyat (periodicity) dekhi: barhte atomic mass se tarteeb dene par har aathwein unsur ki khusoosiyat milti-julti thin, to us ne unhen aise girohon mein rakha jin mein har aathwan unsur pehle se mushabeh tha.

Dmitri Mendeleev, Russian chemist jise periodic table ka baap mana jata hai, ne 1869 mein 63 anasir ko barhte atomic mass se aath amoodi (vertical) columns mein rakha, milti-julti khusoosiyat wale anasir ko amoodi girohon mein mila kar. Us ke table ki kamyabi ghair-daryaft-shuda anasir ke liye khali jagahein chhorne aur un ke atomic mass aur khusoosiyat ki peshgoi mein thi, jo un anasir ke milne par durust sabit hui.
Lothar Meyer ne usi saal atomic volume ko atomic weight ke muqable mein plot kiya; us ke curves ne bhi dauriyat dikhai.

Moseley ne 1913 mein X-ray emission se maloom anasir ke theek atomic numbers maloom kiye aur anasir ko atomic mass ke bajaye atomic number se tarteeb diya, jis se Mendeleev ke table ki khamiyan door huin. Us ne periodic law ko yun badla ke anasir ki khusoosiyat un ke atomic numbers ke periodic functions hain.

blocks.title: Mendeleev
blocks.text: Mendeleev ne anasir ko un ke atomic masses se tarteeb diya, aur us ka table anasir ki darja-bandi ki pehli sab se numayan koshish tha.

blocks.prompt: Mendeleev ne apne table mein khali jagahein chhorin; Moseley ne baad mein use dobara tarteeb diya. Har ek ne kya jora, aur Moseley ki tabdeeli ne khamiyan kyun door kin?
blocks.explanation: Mendeleev ki khali jagahon ne abhi daryaft na hone wale anasir ki un ke mass aur khusoosiyat samet peshgoi ki, aur peshgoiyan sach nikli, jis ne table ko qabil-e-aitbar banaya. Magar atomic mass se tarteeb mein kuch anasir ghalat jagah rahe. Moseley ne X-ray emission se atomic numbers nape aur anasir ko atomic number se tarteeb diya, to periodic law atomic number ka function ban gaya aur be-qaidgiyan khatm ho gain.

items: Periodic table 118 anasir ko atomic number, electronic configuration aur dohrai jane wali khusoosiyat se tarteeb deta hai.

Lavoisier (metals aur non-metals), Dobereiner (triads, 1829), Newlands (har aathwan unsur, 1864), Mendeleev (mass se aath columns, peshgoi wali khali jagahein, 1869), Meyer (atomic volume curves) aur Moseley (atomic numbers, 1913; periodic law atomic number se).
